title: DATE ( 2008, 1, 2.5 ) is January 3, 2008: a decimal day is rounded

source.quote: DATE rounds decimal arguments to the nearest integer.
source.supports: DAX Guide gives DATE ( 2008, 1, 2.5 ) returning January 3, 2008

source.quote: If day contains a decimal portion, it is rounded to the nearest integer value.
